name: figma
description: Figma design context for coding agents: screenshots, layout as CSS, tokens, comments, design-system search and Code Connect, with your own Figma account.

metadata.short_description: Read Figma designs as code-ready context: screenshot, layout, tokens, comments and Code Connect
metadata.mesh_description: The Figma MCP gives coding agents a real reference to the design instead of guessing. **Design to code** - get_design_context returns a screenshot plus a one-line-per-layer outline with auto-layout as flexbox CSS, sizes, colors, typography, component props, real text and the design comments pinned to the frame; get_metadata, get_screenshot, download_assets (SVG/PNG/original image fills), get_variable_defs, get_motion_context (prototype transitions) and get_figjam cover the rest. **Design systems** - get_libraries discovers the libraries a file uses and search_design_system finds published components and styles. **Code Connect** - mappings from main components to code are stored as Figma dev resources (visible in Dev Mode): get_code_connect_map, get_code_connect_suggestions, get_context_for_code_connect and add_code_connect_map. Tool names follow Figma's official MCP server. **Authentication** - each user connects their own Figma account via OAuth; access and rate limits follow that account's seat (use a Dev or Full seat: View/Collab seats get only a few design reads per month). Creating or editing layers is not available: the Figma REST API is read-only for design content.
